definitions.full: H7400. rakil רָכִיל noun [masculine] slander , > tale-bearer, in-former; — always ׳ר absolute; — ׳ר יַהֲלֹךְ Jer 9:3 , ר ׳תֵּלֵךְ Lev 9:16 (H), ר ׳הוֺלֵךְ Prov 11:13 ; 20:19 , all of going about in slander , as slander (Ges § 118q ); ר ׳הֹלְבֵי Jer 6:28 goers of slander (slanderous persons) (compare הָלַךְ ); ר ׳אַנְשֵׁי Ezek 22:9 men of slander , informers.

occurrences.englishText: “ ‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people.
One who brings gossip betrays a confidence,
He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets;
They are all grievous rebels, going around to slander. They are bronze and iron. All of them deal corruptly.
Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood. In you they have eaten on the mountains. They have committed lewdness among you.
